title: Français 23054 — Blasco, 2 May 1597
contents: Juan Blasco reports court negotiations, the prospect of coming with the princess, and efforts to obtain royal favors. He discusses a gift for Don Cristóbal and the support of Don Juan, Chinchón and Miranda.
status: 3/4 pages transcribed; 1 more in part; 3/3 cipher pages deciphered

excerpt: por fuerça [?] con el parecer de todos los amigos. No ay duda que lo de **venir con la princesa** como dize V. E., siendo con las condiciones que V. E. apunta, seria lo que mejor estuviesse, pero hasta agora no ay nada en esto, a lo menos no lo sabemos.
translation: By force [?], with the opinion of all our friends. There is no doubt that coming with the princess, as Your Excellency says, on the conditions Your Excellency specifies, would be best; but so far there is nothing in this, at least as far as we know.

excerpt: Estamos tratando con don Baltasar de hacer **algun presente a don Christoual**, que es el que **mand[a] todo**, y no se perdera ocasion ninguna en que se ofrezca hacer el servicio de V. E. que no se haga.
translation: We are discussing with Don Baltasar giving some present to Don Cristóbal, who commands everything; no opportunity to serve Your Excellency will be left unused.
